facts.material: cordless electric drill, worklight, battery charger, rechargeable battery, drill bits, nylon storage bag
facts.function: drilling (with accessories for powering, lighting and storing)
facts.form: retail set of different articles packaged together for sale

gri_path: GRI 1: components fall in different headings (drill 8467, worklight 8513, charger 8504, battery 8507, bits 8207, bag 4202); no single heading covers the whole
GRI 3(a): each heading covers only part of the set, so they are equally specific

GRI 3(b): retail set put up for a specific activity (drilling) and sold without repacking; the rechargeable drill gives the essential character by its role in use; battery, charger, bits and bag serve the drill and the worklight is ancillary
GRI 6: 8467.21 drills of all kinds; rotary; battery powered -> 8467.21.00.10

rejected_alternatives.reason: the worklight is a secondary item and does not give the set its essential character
the battery only powers the tools; the drill performs the activity the set is sold for
the charger is an accessory to the battery, not the essential character
applies to drills that are not rotary battery powered, including hammer drills; this is a rechargeable rotary drill

missing_facts: Whether the drill is a hammer drill (would change the suffix)
classification.rationale: The kit is a retail set of articles from several headings, put up together for drilling. Under GRI 3(b) the rechargeable drill gives the essential character: the battery, charger, bits and bag support it, and the worklight is incidental. The set is therefore classified as a battery-powered rotary drill in 8467.21.00.10. CBP applied GRI 3(b) to cordless tool kits with chargers and accessories in HQ H86275 and NY F86724 (both in force).
